product.description: TRONUL GOL este al optulea roman din seria de succes Ultimul regat scrisă de Bernard Cornwell, o cronică a istoriei Angliei de la inceputurile sale, bdquo;la fel de captivantă ca Urzeala tronurilor, dar inspirată din evenimente realeldquo; (The Observer), serie care a stat la baza unui excepţional serial de televiziune realizat de BBC. ANGLIA, inceputul secolului al X-lea, o perioadă de profunde schimbări. Icirc;n timpul noilor raiduri vikinge, AElig;thelred, conducătorul Merciei, moare fără a lăsa un moştenitor legitim. Saxonii din vest işi doresc conducerea, dar Uhtred a susţinut-o mult timp pe AElig;thelflaed, sora regelui Edward al Wessexului şi văduva lui AElig;thelred. Foarte iubită şi respectată, aceasta are toate calităţile unui lider, dar ar putea oare războinicii saxoni să accepte vreodată o femeie drept conducător? BER NARD CONWELL scrie un roman istoric şi de aventuri excepţional, un roman despre curaj, trădare, datorie, devotament, dragoste şi luptă, aşa cum se văd prin ochii unui războinic a cărui loialitate este impărţită intre două lumi. bdquo;Cornwell combină perfect istoria şi personalităţile Angliei secolului al X-lea cu nenumărate scene de bătălie şi trădare. # The Last Kingdom: The Empty Throne by Bernard Cornwell

Step back into a time of brutal conflict and enduring legacy with *The Last Kingdom: The Empty Throne*. This powerful novel, penned by acclaimed author Bernard Cornwell, is the eighth installment in the critically beloved saga chronicling the tumultuous dawn of Anglo-Saxon England. If you are looking for an epic blend of history, adventure, and high dramaâa narrative as gripping as a royal court intrigue but grounded in real historical eventsâthis book delivers.

***

## âï¸ A Saga of Survival: Conflict in Anglo-Saxon England

Set at the beginning of the 10th century, *The Empty Throne* plunges readers into a period of profound upheaval across England. The land is constantly threatened by devastating Viking raids, forcing kingdoms to fight for survival and legitimacy.

At the heart of this struggle are characters caught between shifting loyalties. Following the death of Aethelred, the leader of Mercia dies without a clear heir. While Saxon lords vie for control, Uhtred remains fiercely devoted to Aethelflaed, sister to King Edward of Wessex and widow of Aethelred.

Aethelflaed is portrayed as a woman possessing every quality of a true leader. But can the warrior Saxons ever truly accept a queen ruling in times of war? Bernard Cornwell masterfully weaves together themes of courage, betrayal, duty, love, and relentless warfare through the eyes of Uhtredâa warrior whose loyalty is constantly pulled between two warring worlds.

## ðï¸ Why Readers Love The Last Kingdom Series

Bernard Cornwell has a rare gift for historical fiction; he seamlessly merges meticulous historical detail with breathtaking action sequences. This book captures the raw spirit of Anglo-Saxon life, making it an unparalleled reading experience for fans of epic sagas.

The series is not only acclaimed for its literary merit but has also been adapted into an exceptional BBC television serial, solidifying its place in modern historical fiction. As noted by *Library Journal*, Cornwell perfectly combines the history and personalities of 10th-century England with countless scenes of battle and treachery. If you have enjoyed rich historical narratives, this series is highly recommended reading.

*The Empty Throne* offers a deep dive into the complexities of leadership, war, and identityâall unfolding against the backdrop of one of historyâs most dramatic periods.

**Q: Is *The Empty Throne* the first book in the series?**

**Q: What historical period does this book cover?**
